title: A repo's first triage makes its waiting page
why: shiv, Oct 31 15:02 CDT, chat with triage: "as soon as like the first triage occurs it should auto spawn the artifact". Gap read from main: skill waiting-page makes a page only at a repo's roll-out, on the owner's grant; project-ops builds the roadmap block but never makes the page; a triage whose repo has no page (layout.py waiting-page prints unknown) asks in chat.
note: Ruled Oct 31 15:02 CDT (shiv): the first triage in a repo makes the page when none exists. Lane: shared with fork-own-page (session ...KzvCnTqNk7gg7sMmUM), started Oct 31 15:03 CDT, because the files overlap. Fix: at triage start, when layout.py waiting-page prints unknown, triage runs skill waiting-page 'Make a repo's page' (same page.html, repo colour and icon, meta/page writer = triage) and writes the waiting-page key to the repo's .claude/layout-extras.json, with no separate grant; the coordinator-and-triage setup is the grant. It never marks the repo rolled-out (decision one-layout-every-repo). A fork follows step fork-own-page. The lane lands the ruling in a decision record (questions-go-to-owner or session-tiers) and updates skills waiting-page and project-ops (triage role template). Done check: a triage start in a test repo with no page key makes exactly one page and one extras key; a second start makes none. Needs no answer. Files: skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md, skills/project-ops/SKILL.md and templates, lint/layout.py. Done: #901 in batch 39 #916, main d657e1da (coordinator, Oct 31 20:01 CDT).
